name: claude-limits-meter
description: Unofficial. Your Claude Code 5-hour session and 7-day weekly usage in the status bar. Works on Linux, macOS, Windows, WSL and remote hosts.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The extension reads your Claude Code login and sends it to Anthropic, and a workspace's settings could steer it: it runs only in a workspace you trust.

commands.title: Claude Limits Meter: Open Credentials File

claudeLimitsMeter.pollIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between usage checks, from 15 to 86400 (a day). Checks are skipped while the VS Code window is unfocused.

claudeLimitsMeter.showWeekly.description: Show the 7-day weekly usage next to the 5-hour session in the status bar (for example "5h 42% · 7d 18%"). Off shows the 5-hour session alone.

claudeLimitsMeter.refreshExpiredToken.markdownDescription: Renew an expired Claude token from this extension instead of waiting for Claude Code to do it. Uses Claude Code's OAuth client id and writes the renewed login back to `~/.claude/.credentials.json`. Refresh tokens rotate, so if the write-back fails Claude Code may need you to sign in again. Not available for a login stored in the macOS Keychain (the extension never writes to it). Only read from your User settings: a value in a workspace's `.vscode/settings.json` is ignored.

claudeLimitsMeter.clientId.markdownDescription: OAuth client id used when `#claudeLimitsMeter.refreshExpiredToken#` is on. Leave empty to detect it from the installed Claude Code extension. Only read from your User settings: a value in a workspace's `.vscode/settings.json` is ignored.
